project.name: Library Room Booking
project.overview: Students book study rooms in the university library.

stakeholders.name: Student
stakeholders.description: Enrolled student with a university account.

requirements.title: Fair room usage
requirements.description: The library wants study rooms to be shared fairly between students.

requirements.title: Book a room
requirements.description: A student shall be able to book a free study room for a time slot of 1 to 3 hours.

requirements.title: Cancel a booking
requirements.description: A student shall be able to cancel their own booking until its start time.

requirements.title: Booking response time
requirements.description: Booking confirmation shall be shown within the response-time target.
requirements.fit_criterion: 95% of booking requests complete in under 2 seconds with 200 concurrent users
requirements.rationale: Suggested by the assistant; not yet confirmed.

rules.statement: A student may hold at most 2 future bookings at the same time.
Login uses the existing university single sign-on.
Room opening hours are the library opening hours.

issues.description: The maximum number of bookings per student was not stated.
issues.question: How many future bookings may one student hold?
issues.resolution: User confirmed a limit of 2 in round 1 (BRL-001).

issues.description: The response-time target is a suggestion and has not been confirmed.
issues.question: Is 2 seconds for 95% of bookings acceptable?

user_stories.goal: book a study room for a time slot
user_stories.benefit: I have a quiet place to study
the room becomes available to others

acceptance_criteria.title: Book a free room
given: I am logged in as a student
room R1 is free from 10:00 to 12:00
when: I book room R1 from 10:00 to 12:00
then: room R1 is shown as taken from 10:00 to 12:00

acceptance_criteria.title: Reject a slot longer than 3 hours
given: I am logged in as a student
when: I try to book a room for 3 hours and 1 minute
then: the booking is rejected with the message 'Maximum 3 hours'

reasons.clarity: Single action with a clear actor and object.

reasons.completeness: Target not yet confirmed by the user.
